user_query: My company is organizing a conference in Croatia. Can you provide me with the public holidays in Croatia for the month of October? Also, I need to gather information about a specific company in Croatia. Please search the Croatian company register using the MBS identifier and expand the relations.

TaskList.description: Retrieve public holidays in Croatia for the month of October.
Search the Croatian company register using the MBS identifier to gather company information.
Expand the relations of the specific company retrieved from the Croatian company register.
